title: Units sold per product
statementMd:
For every product that has been ordered, show its name and total units sold across all orders (cancelled included).

Expected columns: `name`, `units`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
